fields.name: token
fields.label: API token
fields.note: Create an account token or workspace token in Account Settings → Tokens. An account token with No workspace can access all your resources; a workspace token is limited to the selected workspace.

config.hint: Use RAILWAY_API_TOKEN with the Railway CLI or send it as a Bearer token to RAILWAY_API_URL. Account and workspace tokens use the same authentication.

fields.name: projectToken
fields.label: Project token
fields.note: Create a token in the project's Settings → Tokens. It can access only the project environment selected when it was created.

config.hint: Use RAILWAY_TOKEN with the Railway CLI or send it in the Project-Access-Token header to RAILWAY_API_URL. A project token cannot authenticate account-wide queries.
